calculation.description: Twenty-day cross-sectional momentum scaled by the fraction of recent daily movement aligned with its signed direction. Higher values indicate persistent, orderly trends rather than choppy momentum.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC positive in 2020-2022 (+0.036841), 2023-2024 (+0.028612), and 2025-2027 (+0.013802). Five- and ten-day predictive power was stronger than the admission horizon, consistent with the 10-trading-day rebalance cadence. Small 15-asset universe warrants conservative interpretation.
